title: Determine the active remaining bit status
goal: uses if, else if and else to return the corresponding status for the number of remaining digits in the three segments.
summary: Branch conditions are checked sequentially. Once the first true condition is found, the corresponding branch is executed. Execute else when none of the previous conditions are met.
tasks: completes seatStatus(seatsLeft), the parameter is a non-negative integer, indicating the remaining seats in the activity.
Returns "is full" for 0 places, "is almost full" for 1 to 3 places, and "can be registered" for 4 or more places.
first determines 0 places, and then determines whether it falls within the range that is about to be full.

example.note: tuning panel first filters out values 90 and above. The second branch handles values ​​up to 60 and below 90.

hint: If 1 quota is displayed as full, check whether the first condition contains 1. The condition for the quota to be full is that the remaining quota is exactly 0.
